plan.notes: Hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from the official Case Western Reserve University General Bulletin (2026-27) Business Management, BSM 'Sample Plan of Study' grid (https://bulletin.case.edu/management/programs/business-management-bsm/business-management-bsm.pdf). The bulletin advises majors to take ACCT 100, ECON 102 and MGMT 201 as early as possible, and recommends MGMT 198, MGMT 205 and ACCT 106. Footnotes quoted from the bulletin: (a) Unified General Education Requirement; (b) 'Not required for the specific BS Management degree requirements, but highly encouraged and counts towards the 122 credits required for the degree.'; (c) on DESN 210: 'Students may take MATH 126 (4 credit hours) or MATH 122 (4 credit hours) instead to fulfill the degree requirement.'; (d) on BAFI 361: 'Students may take ECON 326 (4 credit hours) or MKMR 310 (3 credit hours) instead to fulfill the major requirement.' REPEATED COURSE: the official plan places MGMT 395 Seminar (1 cr) in Year 3 Fall, Year 3 Spring, and Year 4 Fall, matching the requirements note 'Taken three times'; allow_repeated_courses is set for this reason. 'Core Requirement', 'Concentration Course', 'WSOM Elective', and unlabeled slots are choice placeholders for student-selected courses. Footnote-b rows are elective choice placeholders naming the recommended option. Prerequisites are not printed in the sample plan, so prereq arrays are empty; prerequisites live in the bulletin's course descriptions.
